To: ada@example.com
Subject: Gmail asked to forward to your Permaily mailbox

Google confirmed that a Gmail account asked to forward its mail to one of your Permaily mailboxes.

Open Accounts in the app to see which Gmail account asked. Enter the code in Gmail only if that account is yours.

    When: 12 November 2026, 09:30 UTC

If you didn't ask, do nothing: no mail is forwarded until the code is entered in Gmail.
